chunks.title: FAQ
chunks.heading: FAQ > Experience
chunks.text:
André has more than twenty years of backend experience, mostly building platforms for companies in the
United States. He works with Python, REST APIs and event-driven systems on AWS.

chunks.title: FAQ
chunks.heading: FAQ > Cloud
chunks.text:
On AWS he has used Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB, Kinesis, SQS and S3 to build serverless pipelines that
process millions of events per day.

chunks.title: FAQ
chunks.heading: FAQ > Availability
chunks.text: He works remotely and overlaps with United States and European business hours.

chunks.title: Narrativa de carreira
chunks.heading: Narrativa de carreira > Início
chunks.text:
André começou a programar em PHP e MySQL, criando sistemas para empresas brasileiras antes de migrar para
projetos internacionais.

chunks.title: Narrativa de carreira
chunks.heading: Narrativa de carreira > Sistemas distribuídos
chunks.text:
Liderou a migração de um monólito para serviços orientados a eventos, com filas e processamento
assíncrono, reduzindo o tempo de resposta das integrações.

chunks.title: How this site works
chunks.heading: How this site works > Retrieval
chunks.text:
Each question runs a hybrid search that fuses vector similarity and full-text matching with reciprocal
rank fusion, then reranks the best passages with a local cross-encoder.

chunks.title: How this site works
chunks.heading: How this site works > Verification
chunks.text:
Every claim of an answer carries a citation to the passage that backs it, and unsupported claims are
removed before the answer is shown.
